blocks.html: One shop for all your custom apparel in Colorado Springs. ARK does screen printing, DTF printing, and embroidery in-house — printed shirts, embroidered hats, decorated jackets, and more. Whether you need 1 item or 500, we handle it.

Our Services

Screen printing & embroidery Colorado Springs — ARK does both in-house. Not sure which method is right? We'll figure it out together.

No Minimum

DTF Printing

Direct to Film printing for orders of any size — even a single shirt. Full-color designs, no setup fees, 3–5 day turnaround. The right choice for small orders and complex artwork.

Learn About DTF Printing
Best for 6+ Shirts

Screen Printing

Ink-on-fabric screen printing for teams, events, and bulk orders. The most durable print method available — ideal for uniforms, merchandise, and any order where per-shirt price matters.

Learn About Screen Printing
Hats, Polos & More

Custom Embroidery

Thread stitched directly into the fabric for a professional, three-dimensional look. Perfect for hats, polos, jackets, and uniforms. Logo digitizing included at no extra cost.

Learn About Embroidery

Not sure whether DTF or screen printing is right for your order? Read our full comparison guide.

Who We Work With

ARK works with businesses, teams, organizations, and individuals across Colorado Springs and nationwide.

Small Businesses

Branded uniforms, embroidered polos, and promotional apparel.

Sports Teams

Jerseys, practice shirts, and team gear in any quantity.

Events & Organizations

Printed shirts, embroidered hats, and volunteer gear for events.

Trades & Contractors

Workwear and uniforms that hold up on the job site.

Schools & Nonprofits

Spirit wear, fundraiser shirts, and staff apparel.

Individuals

One shirt? No problem. DTF printing with no minimum order.

Why ARK?

ARK Screen Printing is a Colorado Springs shop that does everything in-house — screen printing, DTF printing, and embroidery all under one roof. That means faster turnaround, better quality control, and one point of contact for your entire order.

We print from 1 shirt to 1,000. Small orders use DTF so there's no minimum and no wasted setup cost. Larger orders use screen printing for maximum value. Need printed shirts and embroidered hats for the same event? We handle both.

We also ship nationwide — so if you're not local to Colorado Springs, you can still get ARK quality delivered to your door.
